Current errata, IIRC, is that the damage from Riposte (and Mariel
aswell, for example) resolves immediately after the combat (oustide of
combat) and you can't play cards to prevent it so I don't think you
could play Disarm. Disarm has to be played inside of combat, which the
damage isn't.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> In article <33CFA488...@post1.com>, faust <fa...@post1.com> writes
> >I like to know..If a vampire uses something like Riposte to end
> >combat..can Disarm be used?
> >Must the damage for Disarm come from actual strikes or can cards like
> >Riposte be used?

> Current errata, IIRC, is that the damage from Riposte (and Mariel

> aswell, for example) resolves immediately after the combat (oustide of
> combat) and you can't play cards to prevent it so I don't think you
> could play Disarm. Disarm has to be played inside of combat, which the
> damage isn't.

This is correct.
Disarm can be used if the combat is ended prematurely (with Majesty,
or Riposte, etc.) - but the damage counted by Disarm must have been
dealt during the combat (damage from Riposte is not done during combat,
as Mr. Coupe says).

--
